title: mentha arvensis var. pauliana
intro: Mentha arvensis var. pauliana, commonly known as Japanese peppermint or American watermint, is a variant of the Mentha arvensis plant species. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and stress relief. The health benefits of Mentha arvensis var. pauliana include its ability to ease nausea, alleviate headaches, and provide relief from menstrual cramps, thanks to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthone, limonene, and menthol, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
